# how-to-web Mega Menu

> Reconstruction guidance for the how-to-web Mega Menu organism.

Use [Build DNA](./build-dna.json) as the normative contract. Examples demonstrate different information architectures; they do not replace the contract.

## Platform note

The Popover API is a valid current implementation option for overlay panels, but it is not the normative contract. A conventional disclosure implementation is equally valid when it preserves the same semantics, focus and dismiss behavior.

## Agent instruction

Preserve site-navigation semantics, link-vs-trigger distinction, group hierarchy, disclosure state, click/tap baseline, Escape behavior, normal Tab order, current-page semantics and responsive information architecture. Do not invent hover or navigation destinations.
